provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Оплатил донат, но покупка не появилась.

guidance: A missing purchase needs human review. Ask for purchase time, platform and transaction identifier; never request card details or promise a refund.

target.reply: Для проверки покупки нужен сотрудник. Уточните время оплаты, платформу и идентификатор операции. Не отправляйте реквизиты карты или коды.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: My payment went through but the purchase is missing.

guidance: A missing purchase needs human review. Ask for purchase time, platform and transaction identifier; never request card details or promise a refund.

target.reply: A staff member needs to review the missing purchase. Please provide the purchase time, platform and transaction identifier. Do not send card details or security codes.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Minha conta foi invadida e perdi o acesso.

guidance: Loss of account access needs human review. Ask when access was lost and what error appeared. Never request passwords or promise recovery.

target.reply: A perda de acesso precisa da análise de um responsável. Informe quando aconteceu e qual erro aparece. Não envie senhas nem códigos de acesso.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Alguien entró en mi cuenta y ya no puedo acceder.

guidance: Loss of account access needs human review. Ask when access was lost and what error appeared. Never request passwords or promise recovery.

target.reply: La pérdida de acceso requiere revisión de una persona. Indica cuándo ocurrió y qué error aparece. No envíes contraseñas ni códigos.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Маған себепсіз жаза берілді, тексеруді сұраймын.

guidance: An appeal requires human review. Ask for server, date and stated reason. Do not decide guilt or promise reversal.

target.reply: Жазаға қатысты өтінішті қызметкер тексеруі керек. Серверді, күнін және көрсетілген себебін жазыңыз. Шешім тексеруден кейін қабылданады.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Menga sababsiz jazo berildi, qayta tekshirishni so‘rayman.

guidance: An appeal requires human review. Ask for server, date and stated reason. Do not decide guilt or promise reversal.

target.reply: Jazo bo‘yicha murojaatni xodim tekshirishi kerak. Server, sana va ko‘rsatilgan sababni yozing. Qaror tekshiruvdan keyin qabul qilinadi.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Игрок угрожает найти мой адрес и семью в реальной жизни.

guidance: A threat outside the game requires urgent human review. Ask for event time and the available report materials. Claims are unverified.

target.reply: Угроза вне игры требует срочной проверки человеком. Укажите время события и какие материалы вы можете предоставить. Содержание угроз ещё не проверено.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Another player threatened to find my family outside the game.

guidance: A threat outside the game requires urgent human review. Ask for event time and the available report materials. Claims are unverified.

target.reply: A threat outside the game needs urgent human review. Please provide the event time and describe the materials you can provide. The allegation has not been verified.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Мені чатта балағаттады, шағымымды қараңыз.

guidance: A chat insult allegation requires human review. Ask for server, time and participants. Do not confirm a violation or claim to have watched evidence.

target.reply: Чаттағы оқиғаны қызметкер тексеруі керек. Серверді, уақытын және қатысушыларды көрсетіңіз. Хабарламаңыздағы мәлімдеме әзірге тексерілмеген.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Meni chatda haqorat qilishdi, shikoyatimni ko‘ring.

guidance: A chat insult allegation requires human review. Ask for server, time and participants. Do not confirm a violation or claim to have watched evidence.

target.reply: Chatdagi voqeani xodim tekshirishi kerak. Server, vaqt va ishtirokchilarni ko‘rsating. Xabaringizdagi da’vo hali tekshirilmagan.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Entregué el dinero por un coche y la otra persona no lo entregó.

guidance: A property scam allegation requires human review. Ask for agreed terms, time and participants without confirming fraud.

target.reply: La situación necesita revisión de una persona. Describe lo acordado, el momento y los participantes. El relato no confirma por sí solo una infracción.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Paguei pelo carro e a outra pessoa não entregou o veículo.

guidance: A property scam allegation requires human review. Ask for agreed terms, time and participants without confirming fraud.

target.reply: A situação precisa de análise por uma pessoa. Descreva o acordo, o horário e os participantes. O relato sozinho não confirma uma infração.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: После входа застрял под текстурами у гаража.

guidance: A technical stuck-location report needs a location, server, time and reproduction steps. Do not invent commands or promise teleportation.

target.reply: Уточните сервер, время и точное место у гаража. Опишите действия перед появлением проблемы. Для проверки и дальнейшей помощи нужен сотрудник.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: After joining I became stuck under the map near a garage.

guidance: A technical stuck-location report needs a location, server, time and reproduction steps. Do not invent commands or promise teleportation.

target.reply: Please provide the server, time and exact garage location. Describe the steps before the problem appeared. A staff member needs to review the issue and next steps.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Ойынға кірген сайын қосымша жабылып қалады.

guidance: A repeated crash needs device/platform, game version, server and reproduction steps. No diagnosis is confirmed.

target.reply: Құрылғыны, платформаны, ойын нұсқасын және серверді жазыңыз. Қосымша жабылар алдындағы қадамдарды сипаттаңыз. Себебін қызметкер тексеруі керек.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: O‘yinga har kirganimda ilova yopilib qoladi.

guidance: A repeated crash needs device/platform, game version, server and reproduction steps. No diagnosis is confirmed.

target.reply: Qurilma, platforma, o‘yin versiyasi va serverni yozing. Ilova yopilishidan oldingi qadamlarni tasvirlang. Sababni xodim tekshirishi kerak.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Creo que otro jugador dispara a través de las paredes.

guidance: An allegation of cheating requires human review. Ask for server, event time and observed behavior. Do not equate an allegation or attachment count with proof.

target.reply: Lo que describes necesita revisión de una persona. Indica el servidor, la hora y el comportamiento observado. La sospecha por sí sola no demuestra una infracción.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Suspeito que um jogador atira através das paredes.

guidance: An allegation of cheating requires human review. Ask for server, event time and observed behavior. Do not equate an allegation or attachment count with proof.

target.reply: O comportamento descrito precisa de análise por uma pessoa. Informe o servidor, o horário e o que observou. A suspeita por si só não comprova uma infração.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: После перезахода из аккаунта исчезла машина.

guidance: A missing item requires human review. Ask when it was last seen, server and event sequence. Do not promise restoration.

target.reply: Для проверки пропажи нужен сотрудник. Укажите сервер, когда машину видели в последний раз и что произошло перед перезаходом.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: My vehicle disappeared from the account after reconnecting.

guidance: A missing item requires human review. Ask when it was last seen, server and event sequence. Do not promise restoration.

target.reply: A staff member needs to review the missing vehicle. Please provide the server, when it was last visible and the steps before reconnecting.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Бейне тіркелген, ойыншы мені себепсіз өлтірді.

guidance: Attached material metadata is not evidence review. Ask what the material shows and the time, and keep human review.

target.reply: Оқиғаны қызметкер тексеруі керек. Бейнеде не көрсетілгенін, серверді және уақытын жазыңыз. Қосымшаның болуы оның мазмұны тексерілді дегенді білдірмейді.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Video ilova qilingan, o‘yinchi meni sababsiz o‘ldirdi.

guidance: Attached material metadata is not evidence review. Ask what the material shows and the time, and keep human review.

target.reply: Voqeani xodim tekshirishi kerak. Videoda nima ko‘rsatilganini, server va vaqtni yozing. Ilova borligi uning mazmuni tekshirilganini anglatmaydi.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Здравствуйте!

guidance: A plain greeting can receive a short safe clarification. Ask what help is needed; no decision about an incident is made.

target.reply: Здравствуйте! Опишите, какая помощь нужна, и укажите сервер, если вопрос связан с конкретной ситуацией.

provenance.author: Support Copilot project synthetic examples, authored with AI assistance

messages.text: Hello!

guidance: A plain greeting can receive a short safe clarification. Ask what help is needed; no decision about an incident is made.

target.reply: Hello! Please describe what you need help with and include the server if your question concerns a particular situation.
